No option can be put forward yet: the £400k/year salary constraint was not assessed, so the comparison does not answer your full question.

- The model’s outcomes are very low-robustness and nearly identical. Its most sensitive assumption is **delivery capacity**, an Olumi estimate rather than user evidence.
- The £400k/year limit could not be aligned with the model’s calculated annual-salary-spend factor; its value frame is also unspecified. Therefore no option’s budget compliance was checked.
- The run also assumes “more platform delivery progress is better”; that objective direction was not stated.
